requiredMarkers.rationale: The configuration phase must finish applying settings.
Civ VI must report a completed content reconfiguration.

externalWarningRules.messageRegex: ^Warning: The activation order of mods is not the same as it was with a prior sorting algorithm\.$
externalWarningRules.rationale: Civ VI emits this global notice when comparing its current and legacy action sorting algorithms; it is recorded but is not a component load failure.

Some stock DLC manifests reference optional China localization XML files absent from this installation; only an exact DLC-relative path followed immediately by the stock LocalizedText failure line is external noise.

allowedComponentWarningRules.rationale: The stock Rulers of the Sahara base action reports this error before this project begins applying components.
The stock Rulers of the Sahara XP2 action reports the same external RemoveData error.
The stock Catherine de Medici persona action reports this external Modifiers XML error.
